definition_en: in the space or time that separates two things
core_image: 两排书架之间的一条窄过道
scene: 两排书架之间留着一条窄过道。A narrow path runs between the two shelves.
sceneCN: 这里 between 是「在……之间」（第 1 个义项：处在两个事物中间的空间）；句意是两排书架之间有一条窄道。

derivatives.zh: 语义关联词，义为「中间的」，对应 between 所处的层级
语义关联词，义为「间隔」，对应 between 划出的空档

senses.title: In the space separating two things
senses.definition: in the space that separates two things
senses.definitionCN: 处在两个事物中间的空间
senses.example: A narrow path runs between the two shelves.
senses.exampleCN: 两排书架之间有一条窄道。
senses.why: This is the oldest spatial sense, built on the idea of two points.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的空间义，建立在「两个点」的观念上。

senses.title: During the time separating two events
senses.definition: in the period that separates two events
senses.definitionCN: 处在两个事件中间的那段时间
senses.example: Please do not talk between classes.
senses.exampleCN: 课间请不要讲话。
senses.why: Time was pictured as a line, so the gap between events took the word.
senses.whyCN: 时间被想成一条线，两个事件之间的空档就用了这个词。

senses.title: Shared by two sides
senses.definition: shared or divided by two or more people
senses.definitionCN: 由两方或多方共同分配
senses.example: They divided the money between them.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把钱分了。
senses.why: A space between two sides became a share held by both.
senses.whyCN: 两方之间的空间，转为双方共有的份额。

intro.en: Between comes from an Old English phrase meaning by two.
intro.cn: between 来自一个意为「由两者」的古英语短语。

items.en: betweonum meant among two.
items.cn: betweonum 意为「在两者之间」。

items.en: the word settled as between.
items.cn: 这个词定型为 between。

items.en: between also marked a period of time.
items.cn: between 也开始标记一段时间。

items.en: between you and me became a phrase.
items.cn: between you and me 成为固定说法。

items.en: between usually takes two named things.
items.cn: 如今 between 通常接两个明确的对象。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- opening; the near-meaning group gives words for being among things.
note.cn: 形近组都以 be- 开头；近义组是表示处在其中的词。

entries.definition: in the middle of a group

normalIntro.en: Between marks the gap that belongs to two things at once.
normalIntro.cn: between 标记同时属于两样东西的那道空隙。

normal.en: Between usually names two things.
normal.cn: between 通常接两个对象。

normal.en: Among is used for groups of more than two.
normal.cn: 三者以上多用 among。

normal.en: Between you and me means keep it secret.
normal.cn: between you and me 指私下说。

normal.en: In between works as an adverb.
normal.cn: in between 可作副词用。

normal.en: The word never changes its form.
normal.cn: 这个词形式从不变化。

abstract.en: See a narrow aisle between two shelves.
abstract.cn: 想象两排书架间的窄道。

abstract.en: See two classes with a short break between.
abstract.cn: 想象两节课之间短短的休息。

abstract.en: See one pie cut into two shares.
abstract.cn: 想象一个派被分成两份。

examples.en: A narrow path runs between the two shelves.
examples.cn: 两排书架之间有一条窄道。

examples.en: Please do not talk between classes.
examples.cn: 课间请不要讲话。

examples.en: They divided the money between them.
examples.cn: 他们把钱分了。

dict_mnemonic.text: be 加 tw 加 een，tw 提示 two，站在两者中间就是 between。

root: 古英语 betweonum 由 be- 与 tweonum（两者）构成，本义「在两者之间」，中古英语定型为 between，后扩展到时间与分配关系。

sensesIntro.en: A gap in space, a gap in time and a shared share all sit between.
sensesIntro.cn: 空间里的空隙、时间里的空档、双方共有的份额，都落在 between 之间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow aisle between two shelves.
core.cn: 核心意象：两排书架间的窄道。

intro.en: Between is a fixed form with no endings of its own.
intro.cn: between 形式固定，没有自己的词尾变化。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古英语。

definition_en: on the other side of something, or more than a limit
core_image: 越过山脊后展开的陌生平原
scene: 翻过山脊，眼前展开一片陌生平原。The village lies beyond the hills.
sceneCN: 这里 beyond 是「在……那边」（第 1 个义项：位于某物的另一侧）；句意是村庄在山的那一边。

derivatives.zh: 语义关联词，义为「超过」，对应 beyond 的越界含义
语义关联词，义为「胜过」，对应 go beyond 的含义

senses.title: On the other side
senses.definition: on the far side of something
senses.example: The village lies beyond the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 村庄在山的那一边。
senses.why: This is the oldest spatial sense, looking past a boundary.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的空间义，视线越过一条界线。

senses.title: More than a limit
senses.definition: greater than a limit or ability
senses.example: The price is beyond our budget.
senses.exampleCN: 这个价格超出了我们的预算。
senses.why: Crossing a physical line became crossing any limit.
senses.whyCN: 越过实际的界线，引申为越过任何限度。

senses.title: Later than a point in time
senses.definition: later than a stated time
senses.example: Do not stay out beyond ten.
senses.exampleCN: 十点以后别待在外面。
senses.why: Time was treated as a line that can be crossed.
senses.whyCN: 时间被当作一条可以越过的线。

intro.en: Beyond is be- plus yond, an old word for the far side.
intro.cn: beyond 是 be- 加上 yond，后者是表示「那边」的古词。

items.en: begeondan meant on the far side.
items.cn: begeondan 意为「在另一边」。

items.en: beyond became the usual form.
items.cn: beyond 成为通用形式。

items.en: the word also meant more than.
items.cn: 这个词也开始表示「超过」。

items.en: beyond belief entered common speech.
items.cn: beyond belief 进入日常表达。

items.en: beyond covers space, limits and time.
items.cn: 如今 beyond 涵盖空间、限度与时间。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- opening; the near-meaning group gives words for passing a point.
note.cn: 形近组都以 be- 开头；近义组是表示越过某点的词。

normalIntro.en: Beyond means on the far side, past a line you can see.
normalIntro.cn: beyond 指在可见界线的另一侧。

normal.en: Beyond the hills means on the far side.
normal.cn: beyond the hills 指山的另一边。

normal.en: Beyond belief means too strange to accept.
normal.cn: beyond belief 指难以置信。

normal.en: Beyond control means no one can stop it.
normal.cn: beyond control 指无法控制。

normal.en: Beyond doubt means certainly true.
normal.cn: beyond doubt 指毫无疑问。

normal.en: The word is fixed in form.
normal.cn: 这个词形式固定。

abstract.en: See a ridge with open land past it.
abstract.cn: 想象山脊之后开阔的土地。

abstract.en: See a price tag above a budget line.
abstract.cn: 想象价签高过预算线。

abstract.en: See a clock passing ten at night.
abstract.cn: 想象夜里时钟越过十点。

examples.en: The village lies beyond the hills.
examples.cn: 村庄在山的那一边。

examples.en: The price is beyond our budget.
examples.cn: 这个价格超出了我们的预算。

examples.en: Do not stay out beyond ten.
examples.cn: 十点以后别待在外面。

dict_mnemonic.text: be 加 yond（那边），站在那边之外，就是 beyond。

root: 古英语 begeondan 由 be- 与 geond（越过）构成，本义「在较远的一边」，中古英语定型为 beyond，后引申为超出限度与迟于某时。

sensesIntro.en: Space, limit and time each have a line that beyond crosses.
sensesIntro.cn: 空间、限度与时间，各自都有一条被 beyond 越过的线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ridge with open land past it.
core.cn: 核心意象：山脊之后开阔的土地。

intro.en: Beyond is a fixed form that takes no endings.
intro.cn: beyond 形式固定，不加词尾。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古英语。

definition_en: a vehicle with two wheels that a person drives by pedalling
core_image: 靠在墙边的旧自行车，链条上还有油
scene: 一辆旧自行车靠在墙边。He rides his bicycle to work.
sceneCN: 这里 bicycle 是「自行车」（第 1 个义项：靠脚踏驱动的两轮车）；句意是他骑自行车上班。

derivatives.zh: 由 bicycle 加 -ist 构成，义为「骑自行车的人」
由 bicycle 加 -ing 构成，义为「骑行运动」
bicycle 的口语缩略形式

senses.title: A two-wheeled vehicle
senses.definition: a vehicle with two wheels driven by pedals
senses.example: He rides his bicycle to work.
senses.exampleCN: 他骑自行车上班。
senses.why: The name joins two Greek roots for two and wheel.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字由表示「二」和「轮」的两个希腊词根合成。

senses.title: To travel by bicycle
senses.definition: to travel on a bicycle
senses.example: They bicycled across the country.
senses.exampleCN: 他们骑车穿越了全国。
senses.why: The noun became a verb for the activity.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，指这项活动。

intro.en: Bicycle was coined in the nineteenth century from Latin and Greek roots.
intro.cn: bicycle 在十九世纪由拉丁与希腊词根新造。

items.en: bicycle named a two-wheeled machine.
items.cn: bicycle 指两轮机械。

items.en: pedals were added to the front wheel.
items.cn: 脚踏被装到前轮上。

items.en: the safety bicycle took its modern shape.
items.cn: 安全型自行车形成现代样式。

items.en: bicycle became everyday transport.
items.cn: 自行车成为日常交通工具。

items.en: bike is the common short form.
items.cn: 如今 bike 是常见简称。

note.en: The look-alike group starts with bi-; the near-meaning group gives riding words.
note.cn: 形近组都以 bi- 开头；近义组是骑行相关词。

normalIntro.en: Bicycle is bi- two plus cycle wheel.
normalIntro.cn: bicycle 就是 bi-（二）加 cycle（轮）。

normal.en: The plural is bicycles.
normal.cn: 复数是 bicycles。

normal.en: Ride a bicycle is the usual verb phrase.
normal.cn: ride a bicycle 是常见动宾搭配。

normal.en: A bicycle lane is for bikes only.
normal.cn: bicycle lane 只给自行车用。

normal.en: Bike is the short spoken form.
normal.cn: bike 是口语简称。

normal.en: A bicyclist rides a bicycle.
normal.cn: bicyclist 指骑自行车的人。

abstract.en: See an old bike leaning on a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆旧车靠墙停着。

abstract.en: See two wheels spinning along a lane.
abstract.cn: 想象两个车轮沿车道转动。

abstract.en: See a chain oiled before a long ride.
abstract.cn: 想象长途骑行前上过油的链条。

examples.en: He rides his bicycle to work.
examples.cn: 他骑自行车上班。

examples.en: They bicycled across the country.
examples.cn: 他们骑车穿越了全国。

examples.en: A bicycle lane runs beside the road.
examples.cn: 路边有一条自行车道。

dict_mnemonic.text: bi 是「二」，cycle 是「轮子转圈」，两个轮子转起来就是自行车。

root: 十九世纪用拉丁语 bi-（二）与希腊语 kyklos（轮）新造，指两轮脚踏车；十九世纪八十年代安全型车型定型后普及，口语简称为 bike。

sensesIntro.en: The machine and the act of riding it share one word.
sensesIntro.cn: 两轮的车与骑它的动作共用一个词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old bike leaning on a wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：靠墙的旧自行车。

intro.en: Bicycle takes -s, -ed and -ing, and builds bicyclist.
intro.cn: bicycle 可加 -s、-ed、-ing，并构成 bicyclist。

latinIntro.en: The roots are Latin bi-, two, and Greek kyklos, wheel.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 bi-（二）与希腊语 kyklos（轮）。

definition_en: to offer a price, or to make an effort to get something
core_image: 拍卖师举起木槌等下一个价
scene: 拍卖师举起木槌，等着下一个价。She bid twice for the old painting.
sceneCN: 这里 bid 是「出价」（第 1 个义项：在交易中报出愿付的价钱）；句意是她为那幅旧画出了两次价。

derivatives.zh: 由 bid 加 -der 构成，义为「出价者」
由 bid 加 -ding 构成，义为「竞标」
由 out- 加 bid 构成，义为「出价高于」
由 over- 加 bid 构成，义为「出价过高」

senses.title: To offer a price
senses.definition: to offer a sum of money for something
senses.definitionCN: 为某物报出愿付的价钱
senses.example: She bid twice for the old painting.
senses.exampleCN: 她为那幅旧画出了两次价。
senses.why: This is the commercial sense, heard at auctions and tenders.
senses.whyCN: 这是商业义，常见于拍卖与招标场合。

senses.title: To say farewell
senses.definition: to say goodbye or greet someone formally
senses.example: He bade farewell to his friends.
senses.exampleCN: 他向朋友们道别。
senses.why: The old sense was to announce or command, and farewell kept it.
senses.whyCN: 古义是「宣告、吩咐」，道别保留了这一层。

senses.title: To try to win something
senses.definition: to make an effort to gain something
senses.example: The city will bid to host the games.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市将申办运动会。
senses.why: Offering a price turned into offering a plan or effort.
senses.whyCN: 报出价钱，引申为报出方案或努力。

intro.en: Bid comes from an Old English verb meaning to offer or command.
intro.cn: bid 来自一个意为「提供、吩咐」的古英语动词。

items.en: beodan meant to offer or announce.
items.cn: beodan 意为「提供、宣告」。

items.en: bidden meant to command or ask.
items.cn: bidden 意为「吩咐、请求」。

items.en: bid named a price at an auction.
items.cn: bid 指拍卖中的出价。

items.en: bid for contracts became common.
items.cn: 投标承接合同变得常见。

items.en: the past tense stays bid.
items.cn: 如今过去式仍是 bid。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one letter; the near-meaning group gives offer words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母；近义组是表示报价的词。

entries.definition: to say you will pay or give

normalIntro.en: Bid is the price you offer and the effort you offer.
normalIntro.cn: bid 既是你报出的价钱，也是你付出的努力。

normal.en: The past tense is bid, not bidded.
normal.cn: 过去式是 bid，不是 bidded。

normal.en: Bid for means offer money for.
normal.cn: bid for 指为……出价。

normal.en: The person is a bidder.
normal.cn: 出价的人叫 bidder。

normal.en: Outbid means offer more than others.
normal.cn: outbid 指出价高于别人。

normal.en: Bid farewell is a formal goodbye.
normal.cn: bid farewell 是正式道别。

abstract.en: See an auctioneer holding a wooden hammer.
abstract.cn: 想象拍卖师握着木槌。

abstract.en: See a hand raised with a number.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手举起报出数字。

abstract.en: See a sealed envelope sent for a contract.
abstract.cn: 想象为合同寄出的密封信封。

examples.en: She bid twice for the old painting.
examples.cn: 她为那幅旧画出了两次价。

examples.en: He bade farewell to his friends.
examples.cn: 他向朋友们道别。

examples.en: The city will bid to host the games.
examples.cn: 这座城市将申办运动会。

dict_mnemonic.text: bid 短促有力，像拍卖场上举手喊价的一声。

root: 古英语 beodan 意为「提供、宣告」，中古英语 bidden 转为「吩咐、请求」，十六世纪起指拍卖出价，十九世纪起指投标与申办。

sensesIntro.en: Offering money, offering a farewell and offering an effort share one old verb.
sensesIntro.cn: 报出价钱、道出告别、付出努力，共用一个古老动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an auctioneer holding a wooden hammer.
core.cn: 核心意象：握着木槌的拍卖师。

intro.en: Bid doubles its d before -ing, and takes out- and over-.
intro.cn: bid 加 -ing 要双写 d，并能加 out-、over-。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古英语。

definition_en: large in size, important, or older
core_image: 一头大象堵住了整条小路
scene: 大象慢慢走过来，把小路占满了。A big elephant blocked the narrow path.
sceneCN: 这里 big 是「大的」（第 1 个义项：体积或占地规模大）；句意是一头大象堵住了窄路。

pos.zh: 形容词：大的；重要的；年长的

derivatives.zh: 由 big 加 -g- 与 -ish 构成，义为「略大的」
由 big 加 -ie 构成，口语指「大事、大人物」

senses.title: Large in size
senses.definition: large in size or amount
senses.example: A big elephant blocked the narrow path.
senses.exampleCN: 一头大象堵住了窄路。
senses.why: This is the basic sense, measured against ordinary things.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本义，与普通大小相比而言。

senses.title: Important or serious
senses.definition: important or having a strong effect
senses.example: This is a big decision for the family.
senses.exampleCN: 这对这个家庭是个重大决定。
senses.why: Things that matter loom large in the mind, so size words became value words.
senses.whyCN: 重要的事在脑中显得巨大，于是尺寸词转为价值词。

senses.title: Older
senses.definition: older, used of siblings
senses.example: My big brother taught me to swim.
senses.exampleCN: 我哥哥教我游泳。
senses.why: An older child is bigger, so size stood for age in the family.
senses.whyCN: 年长的孩子个子更大，于是尺寸在家庭里代指年龄。

intro.en: Big appeared in northern English in the Middle Ages with an unclear origin.
intro.cn: big 在中世纪出现于英格兰北部，确切来源不明。

items.en: big meant strong or stout.
items.cn: big 意为「强壮、结实」。

items.en: the word spread south for large size.
items.cn: 这个词向南传播，表示「尺寸大」。

items.en: big also meant important.
items.cn: big 也开始表示「重要」。

items.en: big brother named an older brother.
items.cn: big brother 指哥哥。

items.en: big doubles its g before -er and -est.
items.cn: 如今 big 加 -er、-est 时双写 g。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one vowel; the near-meaning group gives size words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个元音；近义组是表示大小的词。

normalIntro.en: Big covers size, importance and the older brother at once.
normalIntro.cn: big 同时覆盖尺寸、重要性与哥哥这三层。

normal.en: The comparative doubles the g: bigger.
normal.cn: 比较级要双写 g：bigger。

normal.en: Big deal often sounds dismissive.
normal.cn: big deal 常带不以为然的语气。

normal.en: Big also means important.
normal.cn: big 也能表示「重要」。

normal.en: Big brother means an older brother.
normal.cn: big brother 指哥哥。

normal.en: The word is short and ends in a hard g.
normal.cn: 这个词很短，以硬音 g 收尾。

abstract.en: See a huge elephant filling a path.
abstract.cn: 想象大象塞满整条小路。

abstract.en: See a wide door beside a small one.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇大门挨着小门。

abstract.en: See an older brother holding a hand.
abstract.cn: 想象哥哥牵着一只手。

examples.en: A big elephant blocked the narrow path.
examples.cn: 一头大象堵住了窄路。

examples.en: This is a big decision for the family.
examples.cn: 这对这个家庭是个重大决定。

examples.en: My big brother taught me to swim.
examples.cn: 我哥哥教我游泳。

dict_mnemonic.text: big 的 b 像鼓起的肚子，g 像撑开的腿，整个词就是「大」。

root: 中古英语出现于英格兰北部，本义「强壮、结实」，十四世纪南传后转指「尺寸大」，十六世纪起引申为「重要」，近代又用于兄弟姐妹中的年长者。

sensesIntro.en: Size, importance and seniority all look big to the eye.
sensesIntro.cn: 尺寸、重要性、年长，在眼里都显得「大」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a huge elephant filling a path.
core.cn: 核心意象：塞满小路的大象。

intro.en: Big doubles its g before -er and -est, and takes -ish and -ie.
intro.cn: big 加 -er、-est 时双写 g，也能加 -ish、-ie。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the origin of the word is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词的来源并不确定。

definition_en: a bicycle or motorcycle
core_image: 车棚里挤满学生的自行车
scene: 车棚里挤满学生的自行车。She left her bike by the gate.
sceneCN: 这里 bike 是「自行车」（第 1 个义项：两轮脚踏车的口语说法）；句意是她把车停在了门边。

pos.zh: 名词：自行车；摩托车（口语）

senses.title: A bicycle
senses.definition: a bicycle, in everyday speech
senses.example: She left her bike by the gate.

senses.why: This is a clipped form of bicycle, used in casual talk.

senses.title: A motorcycle

senses.example: He rode his bike down the highway.

senses.why: The short word widened from pedals to engines.
senses.whyCN: 这个短词从脚踏车扩大到带发动机的车。

senses.title: To ride a bike
senses.definition: to travel by bicycle
senses.example: We biked along the river.
senses.exampleCN: 我们沿河骑车。
senses.why: The noun became a verb for the activity.

items.en: bike also covered motorcycles.

items.en: mountain bikes gave the word new life.

entries.definition: a long walk in the country

normal.en: The plural is bikes.

normal.en: By bike means travelling on a bike.

normal.en: A bike lane is marked for bikes.

normal.en: In America a bike can mean a motorbike.

normal.en: The verb is biked in the past.
normal.cn: 动词过去式是 biked。

abstract.en: See two wheels turning by a river.

abstract.en: See a helmet hung on handlebars.

sensesIntro.en: One short word covers bicycles, motorbikes and the ride itself.

definition_en: a statement of money owed, a proposed law, or a bird's beak
core_image: 餐馆桌角压着的那张长条账单
scene: 账单压在餐馆桌角，旁边放着找零。He paid the bill and left a tip.
sceneCN: 这里 bill 是「账单」（第 1 个义项：列出应付金额的单据）；句意是他付了账单并留下小费。

derivatives.zh: 由 bill 加 -ing 构成，义为「开票、计费」
由 bill 与 board 复合，义为「广告牌」

senses.title: A statement of money owed
senses.definition: a paper listing money that must be paid
senses.example: He paid the bill and left a tip.
senses.exampleCN: 他付了账单并留下小费。
senses.why: This comes from a word for a sealed document.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自表示「盖印文书」的词。

senses.title: A proposed law
senses.definition: a draft law put before a parliament
senses.definitionCN: 提交议会审议的法律草案
senses.example: The bill passed after a long debate.
senses.exampleCN: 经过长时间辩论，法案通过了。
senses.why: A bill was once a royal document, so laws kept the name.
senses.whyCN: bill 曾是皇家文书，法律沿用了这个名字。

senses.title: A bird's beak
senses.definition: the hard mouth of a bird
senses.example: The bird cleaned its bill on the branch.
senses.exampleCN: 鸟在树枝上擦拭喙。
senses.why: This sense has a separate Old English root, bile.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项另有古英语词根 bile。

intro.en: Bill joins two histories: a Latin document and an Old English beak.
intro.cn: bill 汇合了两条历史：拉丁语的文书与古英语的鸟喙。

items.en: bulla meant a sealed document.
items.cn: bulla 意为「盖印文书」。

items.en: billa named a written list.
items.cn: billa 指书面清单。

items.en: bill meant a note of money owed.
items.cn: bill 指欠款单据。

items.en: parliament used bill for a draft law.
items.cn: 议会用 bill 指法律草案。

items.en: bile meant a bird's beak.
items.cn: 古英语 bile 指鸟喙。

items.en: both senses live on in one spelling.
items.cn: 两个义项在同一个拼写里并存。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one letter; the near-meaning group gives payment words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母；近义组是付款相关词。

entries.definition: a list of goods and money due

normalIntro.en: Bill is paper that asks for money, paper that proposes law, and a bird's hard mouth.
normalIntro.cn: bill 既是要钱的纸、提议法律的纸，也是鸟的硬嘴。

normal.en: The plural is bills.
normal.cn: 复数是 bills。

normal.en: Pay the bill at the counter.
normal.cn: 到柜台付账。

normal.en: A bill can also be a draft law.
normal.cn: bill 也可以指法律草案。

normal.en: A bird's bill is its beak.
normal.cn: 鸟的 bill 就是喙。

normal.en: Billed means charged or advertised.
normal.cn: billed 指被收费或被宣传。

abstract.en: See a long paper slip under a cup.
abstract.cn: 想象杯子下压着的长条单据。

abstract.en: See hands raised to vote on a law.
abstract.cn: 想象举手对法律表决。

abstract.en: See a sparrow wiping its beak.
abstract.cn: 想象麻雀擦拭它的喙。

examples.en: He paid the bill and left a tip.
examples.cn: 他付了账单并留下小费。

examples.en: The bill passed after a long debate.
examples.cn: 经过长时间辩论，法案通过了。

examples.en: The bird cleaned its bill on the branch.
examples.cn: 鸟在树枝上擦拭喙。

dict_mnemonic.text: bill 像一张窄长的纸条，正是一张账单的形状。

root: 表示账单与法案的 bill 源自拉丁语 bulla（盖印文书），经中世纪拉丁语 billa 进入英语；表示鸟喙的 bill 则来自古英语 bile，两条来源合流为同一拼写。

sensesIntro.en: One spelling carries a debt note, a draft law and a bird's mouth.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个拼写承载欠款单、法律草案与鸟嘴三个义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long paper slip under a cup.
core.cn: 核心意象：杯子下压着的长条单据。

intro.en: Bill takes -s, -ed and -ing, and joins board to form billboard.
intro.cn: bill 可加 -s、-ed、-ing，还能与 board 复合成 billboard。

latinIntro.en: The document sense comes from Latin bulla; the beak sense is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 文书义来自拉丁语 bulla，鸟喙义来自古英语。

definition_en: a thousand million, or a very large number
core_image: 屏幕上滚过一长串数字
scene: 屏幕上滚过一长串数字。The company is worth two billion dollars.
sceneCN: 这里 billion 是「十亿」（第 1 个义项：一千个百万）；句意是这家公司值二十亿美元。

derivatives.zh: 由 billion 加 -aire 构成，义为「亿万富翁」
由 billion 加 -th 构成，义为「第十亿的」

senses.title: A thousand million
senses.definition: the number 1,000,000,000
senses.example: The company is worth two billion dollars.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司值二十亿美元。
senses.why: Modern English uses the short scale, where a billion is a thousand million.
senses.whyCN: 现代英语采用短级差制，十亿等于一千个百万。

senses.title: A very large number
senses.definition: a very large number of things
senses.example: Billions of stars fill the sky.
senses.exampleCN: 天上有数十亿颗星星。
senses.why: The number became a word for anything countless.
senses.whyCN: 这个数字转而指任何数不清的东西。

intro.en: Billion was formed in French from bi- and million.
intro.cn: billion 在法语中由 bi- 与 million 组合而成。

items.en: French coined billion for a huge number.
items.cn: 法语造出 billion 表示巨大的数。

items.en: English borrowed the word.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词。

items.en: Britain and America differed on its value.
items.cn: 英美对它的数值曾有不同的理解。

items.en: the short scale spread worldwide.
items.cn: 短级差制在全世界推广。

items.en: billion usually means a thousand million.
items.cn: 如今 billion 通常指十亿。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -illion pattern; the near-meaning group gives other huge numbers.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -illion 结构；近义组是其他巨大数值。

entries.definition: an informal word for a huge number

normalIntro.en: Billion is a thousand million, with bi- hinting at the second big step.
normalIntro.cn: billion 是一千个百万，bi- 提示它比百万又进一大步。

normal.en: Billion has two l letters in the middle.
normal.cn: billion 中间有两个 l。

normal.en: The plural is billions.
normal.cn: 复数是 billions。

normal.en: Billions of means a countless number.
normal.cn: billions of 指数不清的量。

normal.en: A billionaire has a billion or more.
normal.cn: billionaire 指拥有十亿以上财富的人。

normal.en: Billion follows million and precedes trillion.
normal.cn: billion 排在 million 之后、trillion 之前。

abstract.en: See a long row of digits on a screen.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上长长一串数字。

abstract.en: See a night sky packed with stars.
abstract.cn: 想象挤满星星的夜空。

abstract.en: See a city of endless lit windows.
abstract.cn: 想象灯火无尽的城市。

examples.en: The company is worth two billion dollars.
examples.cn: 这家公司值二十亿美元。

examples.en: Billions of stars fill the sky.
examples.cn: 天上有数十亿颗星星。

examples.en: The project cost several billion yuan.
examples.cn: 这个项目花了数十亿元。

dict_mnemonic.text: bi 是「二」，million 是「百万」，第二个百万级台阶就是十亿。

root: 十六世纪法语用 bi- 与 million 造出 billion，英语于十七世纪借入；十九世纪英美对数值理解不同，二十世纪短级差制通行，十亿即一千个百万。

sensesIntro.en: The exact number and the idea of countless both live in billion.
sensesIntro.cn: 精确的十亿与「数不清」的意味都活在 billion 里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long row of digits on a screen.
core.cn: 核心意象：屏幕上长长一串数字。

intro.en: Billion takes -s and -th, and joins -aire for a rich person.
intro.cn: billion 可加 -s、-th，并与 -aire 组合指巨富。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin bi-, two, attached to million.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 bi-（二），接在 million 之前。

definition_en: a container for storing things or for waste
core_image: 厨房角落装着菜叶的桶
scene: 厨房角落的桶里堆着菜叶。He threw the peel into the bin.
sceneCN: 这里 bin 是「垃圾桶」（第 2 个义项：盛放废弃物的容器）；句意是他把果皮扔进了垃圾桶。

pos.zh: 动词：把……扔进垃圾桶；丢弃

derivatives.zh: 由 bin 与 man 复合，英式英语指「垃圾清运工」
由 dust 与 bin 复合，英式英语指「垃圾桶」

senses.title: A storage container
senses.definition: a container for keeping things in
senses.example: Store the rice in a dry bin.
senses.exampleCN: 把米存放在干燥的箱子里。
senses.why: This is the older sense, a simple basket or box.
senses.whyCN: 这是较早的义项，指简单的筐或箱。

senses.title: A waste container
senses.definition: a container for things thrown away
senses.example: He threw the peel into the bin.
senses.exampleCN: 他把果皮扔进了垃圾桶。
senses.why: The same container became the place for rubbish at home.
senses.whyCN: 同一种容器在家里成了丢废弃物的地方。

senses.title: To throw something away
senses.definition: to put something in the bin
senses.example: They binned the old papers.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把旧文件丢了。
senses.why: The container became a verb for the act of discarding.
senses.whyCN: 容器转为动词，表示丢弃的动作。

intro.en: Bin is an Old English word for a basket, probably from Latin.
intro.cn: bin 是古英语中表示筐的词，可能源自拉丁语。

items.en: binne meant a basket or crib.
items.cn: binne 意为「筐、储物格」。

items.en: bins held grain and coal.
items.cn: 箱筐用来装谷物和煤。

items.en: bin named a household rubbish container.
items.cn: bin 指家庭垃圾桶。

items.en: recycling bins appeared in cities.
items.cn: 回收箱出现在城市里。

items.en: bin also works as a verb.
items.cn: 如今 bin 也作动词使用。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one vowel; the near-meaning group gives containers.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个元音；近义组是各类容器。

entries.definition: a container made of woven material

normalIntro.en: A bin holds things, and later holds what we throw away.
normalIntro.cn: bin 先用来装东西，后来装我们丢掉的东西。

normal.en: The plural is bins.
normal.cn: 复数是 bins。

normal.en: A rubbish bin is for waste.
normal.cn: rubbish bin 用来装垃圾。

normal.en: A bin liner keeps the bin clean.
normal.cn: bin liner 让桶保持干净。

normal.en: The verb binned means threw away.
normal.cn: 动词 binned 指丢掉了。

normal.en: British English prefers bin to trash can.
normal.cn: 英式英语更常说 bin。

abstract.en: See vegetable peel piled in a kitchen bin.
abstract.cn: 想象厨房桶里堆着菜叶。

abstract.en: See three coloured bins by a gate.
abstract.cn: 想象门口三只不同颜色的桶。

abstract.en: See a hand dropping paper into a bin.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把纸丢进桶里。

examples.en: He threw the peel into the bin.
examples.cn: 他把果皮扔进了垃圾桶。

examples.en: Store the rice in a dry bin.
examples.cn: 把米存放在干燥的箱子里。

examples.en: They binned the old papers.
examples.cn: 他们把旧文件丢了。

dict_mnemonic.text: bin 的 b 与 n 像桶的两道壁，中间装东西。

root: 古英语 binne 指筐或储物格，可能借自拉丁语；中古英语用来装谷物与煤，十九世纪起指家庭垃圾桶，二十世纪出现分类回收箱，并发展出动词用法。

sensesIntro.en: The same container stores grain and receives rubbish.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一种容器，既存放谷物，也接收垃圾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: vegetable peel piled in a kitchen bin.
core.cn: 核心意象：厨房桶里堆着菜叶。

intro.en: Bin doubles its n before -ed and -ing, and joins man and dust.
intro.cn: bin 加 -ed、-ing 要双写 n，并能与 man、dust 复合。

latinIntro.en: The word is Old English, possibly from Latin benna.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词来自古英语，可能源自拉丁语 benna。

definition_en: to tie things together, or to place an obligation on someone
core_image: 麻绳把一摞纸箱牢牢捆住
scene: 麻绳把纸箱牢牢捆在一起。They bound the boxes with rope.
sceneCN: 这里 bind 是「捆绑」（第 1 个义项：用绳带把东西系在一起）；句意是他们用绳子把箱子捆好。

derivatives.zh: 由 bind 加 -ing 构成，义为「有约束力的」
由 bind 加 -er 构成，义为「装订工、活页夹」
由 un- 加 bind 构成，义为「解开」

senses.title: To tie together
senses.definition: to tie things together with rope or string
senses.definitionCN: 用绳或带把东西系在一起
senses.example: They bound the boxes with rope.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用绳子把箱子捆好。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, working with hands and rope.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，用双手与绳索完成。

senses.title: To fasten pages into a book
senses.definition: to fasten pages together as a book
senses.example: The pages were bound in leather.
senses.exampleCN: 书页被装订上皮面。
senses.why: Binding a book is tying pages the way rope ties boxes.
senses.whyCN: 装订书就是像捆箱子那样把书页系住。

senses.title: To place an obligation
senses.definition: to place a legal or moral duty on someone
senses.definitionCN: 给某人加上法律或道义上的义务
senses.example: The contract binds both sides.
senses.exampleCN: 这份合同对双方都有约束力。
senses.why: A promise ties a person the way rope ties a load.
senses.whyCN: 承诺把人系住，就像绳子系住货物。

intro.en: Bind is an ancient Germanic verb for tying.
intro.cn: bind 是日耳曼语中表示「系、捆」的古老动词。

items.en: bindan meant to tie.
items.cn: bindan 意为「捆绑」。

items.en: bind also meant to make a book.
items.cn: bind 也开始表示「装订」。

items.en: the word described legal duty.

items.en: bound became the past tense.
items.cn: bound 成为过去式。

items.en: binding means having force.
items.cn: 如今 binding 表示「有约束力」。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one vowel; the near-meaning group gives tying words.

entries.definition: to join one thing to another

normalIntro.en: Bind ties rope, pages and promises alike.
normalIntro.cn: bind 把绳索、书页与承诺一样系住。

normal.en: The past tense is bound.
normal.cn: 过去式是 bound。

normal.en: Binding means having legal force.
normal.cn: binding 指具有法律效力。

normal.en: A binder holds loose pages.
normal.cn: binder 是装活页的夹子。

normal.en: Bind up a wound means wrap it.
normal.cn: bind up a wound 指包扎伤口。

normal.en: Unbind means to set free.
normal.cn: unbind 指解开、释放。

abstract.en: See rope pulled tight around boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象绳子紧勒住纸箱。

abstract.en: See hands pressing pages into a cover.
abstract.cn: 想象双手把书页压进封皮。

abstract.en: See a signed contract on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上签好的合同。

examples.en: They bound the boxes with rope.
examples.cn: 他们用绳子把箱子捆好。

examples.en: The pages were bound in leather.
examples.cn: 书页被装订上皮面。

examples.en: The contract binds both sides.
examples.cn: 这份合同对双方都有约束力。

dict_mnemonic.text: b 与 d 像两根柱子，中间用绳捆住，就是 bind。

root: 古英语 bindan 意为捆绑，中古英语起用于装订书籍，十四世纪引申出法律与道义上的约束，过去式 bound 沿用至今。

sensesIntro.en: Rope, bookbinding and contracts all bind in the same way.
sensesIntro.cn: 绳索、装订与合同，都用同一种方式「系住」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rope pulled tight around boxes.
core.cn: 核心意象：绳子紧勒住纸箱。

senses.title: With deep pain
senses.definition: in a way that shows great sadness or suffering
senses.definitionCN: 以表现出深切悲伤或痛苦的方式
senses.example: She wept bitterly after the letter arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 信到之后她痛哭起来。
senses.why: The suffix -ly turned the taste word into a way of showing pain.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ly 把这个味道词变成了表现痛苦的方式。

senses.title: With strong resentment
senses.definition: in a way that shows anger and a sense of unfairness
senses.definitionCN: 以表现出愤怒与不公之感的方式
senses.example: He complained bitterly about the decision.
senses.exampleCN: 他愤愤地抱怨那个决定。
senses.why: The anger sense of bitter passed straight into the adverb.
senses.whyCN: bitter 的怨恨义直接进入了副词。

senses.title: To an extreme degree
senses.definition: used with words like cold to mean very severely
senses.definitionCN: 与 cold 等词连用，表示程度极其严重
senses.example: It was bitterly cold on the platform.
senses.exampleCN: 站台上冷得刺骨。
senses.why: Bitter cold was so sharp that the adverb became a general intensifier.
senses.whyCN: 刺骨的寒冷太强烈，副词因而成了泛用的程度加强词。

intro.en: Bitterly is bitter plus the old adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: bitterly 是 bitter 加上古老的副词词尾 -ly。

items.en: biter meant sharp to the taste.
items.cn: biter 意为味道尖锐的。

items.en: the ending -lice formed adverbs from adjectives.
items.cn: 词尾 -lice 把形容词变成副词。

items.en: bitterliche became the modern bitterly.
items.cn: bitterliche 演变为今天的 bitterly。

items.en: bitterly described weeping and grief.
items.cn: bitterly 开始形容哭泣与悲伤。

items.en: bitterly also strengthens cold and disappointment.
items.cn: 如今 bitterly 也用来加强寒冷与失望的程度。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -tterly shape; the near-meaning group gives other adverbs of intensity.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -tterly 的词形；近义组是其他表示程度的副词。

normalIntro.en: Bitterly tells how something bitter is done or felt.
normalIntro.cn: bitterly 说明一件苦事是以怎样的方式发生或被感受的。

normal.en: Add -ly to bitter to get the adverb.
normal.cn: bitter 加 -ly 就是副词。

normal.en: Weep bitterly is the most common pairing.
normal.cn: weep bitterly 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: Bitterly cold means extremely cold.
normal.cn: bitterly cold 表示冷到极点。

normal.en: Complain bitterly shows lasting anger.
normal.cn: complain bitterly 显出积压的怒气。

normal.en: The adverb never changes form.
normal.cn: 这个副词形式从不变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: bitter 是苦，ly 是副词尾巴，苦到心里，就成了痛苦地、怨恨地。

root: bitterly 由形容词 bitter 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，-ly 源自古英语 -lice；本义「带苦味地」，中古英语起引申为痛苦地、怨恨地，并常与 cold 连用表示严寒。
